reference: Bash metadata and documented BSCR frame contracts; fixed independent wire encoding and literal decoded values. GNU Screen is not a matching oracle. No live broker or network operation is executed.
coverage: Bash identifies screen as a builtin with type -t.
Bash help -s exposes screen's documented short command synopsis.
Deferred live-session lifecycle and child cleanup.
Deferred pane/window layout, literal argv, PTY attach and detach, raw capture, observer roles, rollback, and remote attach scenarios.
Pure BSCR framing: all three type IDs, empty and nonempty payloads, independent encode and decode checks, usage rejection.
exclusions: No matching GNU CLI is a reliable oracle for this loadable's operation semantics, so there are no parity cases.
No high-volume/backpressure stress, real terminal, SSH/network target, physical display, GPU/Kitty/Sixel frontend, or host session is exercised.

cases.purpose: Check Bash's documented type -t result for a command registered as a shell builtin, without invoking screen.
Check Bash help -s output against screen's registered short synopsis, without invoking screen.
Create a live named session with a deterministic child, verify list/status state after the creating shell exits, then kill it and verify broker and child cleanup.
cases.reason: Requires a disposable Linux VM with /proc, PTYs, Unix SOCK_SEQPACKET, pidfd and subreaper support, plus the ptybroker companion and a private 0700 state directory. Use only a fixture-owned child and verify cleanup before the VM is discarded.

cases.purpose: Create windows and split panes, switch/select focus, resize and swap panes, and compare each fixture child's observed TIOCGWINSZ geometry with screen's reported layout.
cases.reason: Requires a disposable Linux VM with the screen and ptybroker services, private PTYs, and owned fixture children that report their terminal geometry. No host terminal or existing session may be used.

cases.purpose: Pass empty, spaced, quoted, wildcard, newline, and shell-looking arguments after -- through run, win-create, and pane-split; compare the child's argv byte-for-byte and confirm no shell interpretation.
cases.reason: Requires a disposable Linux VM with ptybroker and private PTYs plus a fixture child that records argv. Keep all commands and files within the fixture directory; no real commands or host paths.

cases.purpose: Use a private frontend terminal driver to compare deterministic binary child output, exercise quoted Ctrl-A input and the Ctrl-A then d detach sequence, and verify frontend terminal settings are restored.
cases.reason: Requires a disposable Linux VM with ptybroker, an owned raw-mode child, and a private controlling PTY/terminal driver capable of checking termios restoration. Do not attach to a user or host terminal.

cases.purpose: Have an owned child emit deterministic text, binary bytes, and a terminal query sequence; verify capture returns raw history and a later attach does not replay the old query or claim a parsed terminal grid.
cases.reason: Requires a disposable Linux VM with ptybroker, a private PTY, and an owned child that records query replies. Use a small bounded fixture and a private terminal driver; no physical terminal or history replay into a real display.

cases.purpose: With a small deterministic stream, verify one controller and an observer receive the expected live bytes while observer input is suppressed and neither role terminates the pane on disconnect.
cases.reason: Requires a disposable Linux VM with ptybroker, one owned child, and private attach clients. Keep the stream small and bounded; this case does not induce queue saturation or run a backpressure stress test.

cases.purpose: Check invalid names, malformed pane geometry, missing-session mutations, and controlled child-start failure for documented nonzero outcomes and absence of partial layout or leaked broker state.
cases.reason: Requires a disposable Linux VM with ptybroker and a private state root. To check partial-start rollback, use an owned fixture executable or a reviewed spawn-failure mock; inspect only fixture-owned processes and files.

cases.purpose: Check remote attach/roam command construction and framed byte exchange against an independent protocol encoder, including short, malformed, and valid bounded frames.
cases.reason: Requires a disposable Linux VM with a mocked SSH/transport boundary and an independent BSCR frame encoder/decoder. No network activity, installed credentials, or real remote target is allowed.
